cards.title: AI's next bottleneck is assembly
cards.question: Could advanced packaging capacity matter as much as wafer supply?
cards.selfCheck: Rubin volume needs packaging; track capacity and yields.
cards.prompt: FACT Nov 17 NVIDIA said Rubin NVL72 and Vera CPUs began volume shipments in Q3 and expanded Amkor/SPIL packaging relationships. HYPOTHESIS packaging and test capacity becomes a binding constraint as complex heterogeneous AI systems ramp; more chips do not automatically mean more profitable packages. TEST OSAT utilization, advanced-package shipments, yields, lead times and cost/package. 7d Nov17 supplier update; 30d Oct21 Amkor capacity commitment; 90d Jul23 agreement. https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Expands-Commitments-With-Supply-Chain-Partners-to-Support-AI-Infrastructure-Buildout/default.aspx https://ir.amkor.com/news-releases/news-release-details/amkor-technology-and-nvidia-advance-strategic-partnership-ai

cards.title: AMKR: paid to assemble AI
cards.question: Can Amkor capture incremental AI system value without owning the GPU?
cards.selfCheck: Computing mix rose to 26%; test profit per package.
cards.prompt: FACT Amkor Oct26 Q3 2026 sales $1.991B, computing 26% of sales versus 19% a year earlier; total advanced products $1.632B vs $1.684B a year earlier, so not every advanced metric is growing. NVIDIA Nov17 named Amkor as expanded packaging partner. HYPOTHESIS higher-value heterogeneous assembly raises AMKR computing contribution and utilization; cannot assume all computing is AI. TEST computing mix, advanced-product revenue, gross margin, cash flow. Counter: weak communications, overcapacity, costly ramp. https://ir.amkor.com/news-releases/news-release-details/amkor-technology-reports-financial-results-third-quarter-2026 https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Expands-Commitments-With-Supply-Chain-Partners-to-Support-AI-Infrastructure-Buildout/default.aspx

cards.title: A $3B capacity bridge has a clock
cards.question: When do NVIDIA's Amkor prepayments become operating earnings?
cards.selfCheck: July deal, October expansion; test shipments and margins.
cards.prompt: ORIGINAL Jul23 2026 Amkor announced $1.5B multiyear NVIDIA packaging and development agreement with prepayment. Oct21 Amkor announced $1.3B Korea expansion and said total Arizona/Korea multiyear agreements $3B. NEW Nov17 NVIDIA named Amkor in packaging capacity expansion; Rubin volume shipments began. These agreements are NOT $3B of recognized AMKR revenue and terms may include prepayments and capacity funding. TEST next 2-6 months capacity commissioning, advanced computing shipments, utilization and margin; verify financial accounting. https://ir.amkor.com/news-releases/news-release-details/amkor-technology-announces-strategic-partnership-nvidia-expand https://ir.amkor.com/news-releases/news-release-details/amkor-technology-and-nvidia-advance-strategic-partnership-ai https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Expands-Commitments-With-Supply-Chain-Partners-to-Support-AI-Infrastructure-Buildout/default.aspx

cards.title: Capacity funding isn't free profit
cards.question: Will AMKR's $2.5B 2026 capex earn attractive incremental returns?
cards.selfCheck: Q3 margin improved; test FCF after capex.
cards.prompt: FACT Oct26 Amkor Q3 sales $1.991B, gross profit $364M, operating income $225M; FY26 capex outlook ~$2.5B. Its Q3 computing revenue mix rose from 19% year-ago to 26%; advanced-product revenue declined year over year. HYPOTHESIS customer-backed investment can lower demand risk but capex/depreciation and ramp costs may constrain free cash flow. No verified current forward multiple or analyst consensus; do NOT assert mispricing. TEST incremental operating income, utilization, cash flow after capex, forward EV/EBIT and estimates if verified. https://ir.amkor.com/news-releases/news-release-details/amkor-technology-reports-financial-results-third-quarter-2026 https://ir.amkor.com/news-releases/news-release-details/amkor-technology-and-nvidia-advance-strategic-partnership-ai

cards.title: Watch AMKR; demand cash proof
cards.question: What would make this packaging ramp investable over 2–6 months?
cards.selfCheck: WATCH: require computing growth, margin and FCF; reject misses.
cards.prompt: Educational WATCH, not trade instruction. Evidence: NVIDIA Nov17 expanded packaging capacity commitment and Oct21 Amkor $3B total multiyear agreements; Q3 computing mix 26% vs 19% year-ago. Check next quarterly results for computing mix, gross margin relative to Q4 guide 18-19%, and free cash flow/capex. Compare verified valuation and forward earnings before considering entry; avoid price chasing. Invalidated by prolonged underutilization, capex overruns, shrinking advanced-product sales, deteriorating cash conversion or lost program share. https://ir.amkor.com/news-releases/news-release-details/amkor-technology-reports-financial-results-third-quarter-2026 https://ir.amkor.com/news-releases/news-release-details/amkor-technology-and-nvidia-advance-strategic-partnership-ai https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Expands-Commitments-With-Supply-Chain-Partners-to-Support-AI-Infrastructure-Buildout/default.aspx

cards.title: Follow the customer-funded factory
cards.question: How do you recognize a supplier inflection before EPS?
cards.selfCheck: Trace prepayment → capacity → yield → cash profit.
cards.prompt: Teach the evidence ladder using Amkor Jul23 $1.5B NVIDIA prepayment-backed agreement, Oct21 total $3B agreements, Nov17 NVIDIA capacity update, and Oct26 Q3 computing mix. Customer funding validates strategic intent but not return on capital. Distinguish customer prepayment from supplier revenue, capacity from utilization, shipments from profit. Historical analogy: semiconductor capacity cycles reward disciplined utilization and punish excess capex.
